concerns.text: FR-001 ends with '(See US-1)' but no User Story or requirement labeled 'US-1' exists; the user stories are named 'User Story 1', 'User Story 2', etc.
FR-002 references '(See US-2)' yet there is no identifier 'US-2' defined anywhere in the document.
FR-003 (and FR-004, FR-005) cite '(See US-2)' or '(See US-3)' but the spec only contains 'User Story' sections; the cross‑reference identifiers are undefined, causing ambiguity.
